meaning:
εὔ-θετος, -ον
(τίθημι), [in LXX: Psa.32:6 (מָצָא), From Th Sus 1:15* ;]
ready for use, fit: of things, with dative, Heb.6:7; before εἰς, Luk.14:35; of persons, with dative, Luk.9:62 (for rabbinic parallels, see Dalman, Words, 119 f.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

related.gloss: a feeding on the inwards of a sacrifice
